# 1.0 ---- Summary of Document ----

This file is used to read the GPS data exported from the R/V WeatherBird II or 
the R/V Hogarth. The file extenstions are '.aoc' with a file name containing 
GGA. If need to determine column names, the same file name with the '.tpl' 
extension explains each column with the exception of the first few that 
correspond to date and time.

# 2.0 ---- Setup ----


## 2.1 Load Libraries

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
if (!nzchar(system.file(package = "librarian"))) 
  install.packages("librarian")

librarian::shelf(
  quiet = TRUE,
  librarian, conflicted, ggplot2, tibble, tidyr, readr, purrr, dplyr, stringr,
  forcats, lubridate, glue, fs, magrittr, here,
  
  # additional
  
)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter(), 
  dplyr::select()
  )
  

```

```{r}
# function factory to pre-set metric used to summarise
set_func <- function(metric_name, ...) {
  fun <- switch(
    metric_name,
    mean   = mean,
    median = median,
    min    = min,
    max    = max,
    stop("Unknown metric")
  )
  
  function(x, ...) {
    fun(x, na.rm = TRUE, ...)
  }
}

func <- set_func("median")

# function factory to pre-set time rounding
set_time_func <- function(metric_name, sec, ...) {
  fun <- switch(
    metric_name,
    trunc = hms::trunc_hms,
    round = hms::round_hms,
    stop("Unknown metric")
  )
  
  function(x, ...) {
    fun(x, sec * 60, ...)
  }
}

# number of minutes to bin by
min_bin <- 5

time_fun <- set_time_func("trunc", sec = min_bin)
```


## 2.2 Load Dataset

```{r load-data}
ship_dir <- rstudioapi::selectDirectory()
```


```{r load-data}
ship_path <- 
  ship_dir %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "GGA.aco") %T>% 
  print()
```

```{r}
if (str_detect(ship_path, "(?i)northstar")) {
  ship_data <-
    read_csv(
      ship_path,
      col_names = c("year", "jullian_day_hour", "julian_day", "time",
                    "col1", "col2", "col3", "col4",
                    "lat_dd", "lon_dd", "col5", "col6", "col7")
    ) %>%
    janitor::remove_empty("cols") %>%
    mutate(
      .after = year,
      date   = as_date(paste(year, julian_day), format = "%Y %j"),
      time   = hms::hms(days = time),
      time2  = time_fun(time)
    )
    
  ship_summary <- 
    ship_data %>%
    summarise(
      .by = c(date, time2),
      across(c(lat_dd, lon_dd), ~ func(.x)),
    )
  
} else {
  

  ship_data <-
    read_csv(
      ship_path,
      col_names = c("year", "jullian_day_hour", "julian_day", "time",
                    "lat_deg_dec", "lat_hemi", "lon_deg_dec", "lon_hemi", "empty"),
      col_types = cols("lat_deg_dec" = col_character(), "lon_deg_dec" = col_character())
    ) %>%
    janitor::remove_empty("cols") %>%
    separate_wider_regex(
      lat_deg_dec,
      c(lat_deg = "\\d{2}", lat_min = ".*")
    ) %>%
    separate_wider_regex(
      lon_deg_dec,
      c(lon_deg = "\\d{3}", lon_min = ".*")
    ) %>%
    hablar::retype() %>%
    mutate(
      .before = lat_deg,
      lat_dd  = lat_deg + lat_min / 60,
      lon_dd  = lon_deg + lon_min / 60,
      lon_dd  = if_else(lon_hemi == "W", -lon_dd, lon_dd)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      .after = year,
      date   = as_date(paste(year, julian_day), format = "%Y %j"),
      time   = hms::hms(days = time),
      time2  = time_fun(time)
    )
  
  ship_summary <- 
    ship_data %>%
    summarise(
      .by = c(date, time2),
      across(c(lat_dd, lon_dd), ~ func(.x)),
      across(c(lat_hemi, lon_hemi), ~ first(.x)),
    )
}

slice(ship_data, 1:10)
slice(ship_summary, 1:10)
distinct(ship_summary, date)
```



```{r}
ship_plt <-
  ggplot(ship_summary) +
  geom_path(aes(x = lon_dd, y = lat_dd, color = as.character(date), label = time2)) +
  geom_point(data = test,
             aes(x = x, y = y, label = station), color = "red")
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Date") +
  theme_classic()
  ggplot(ship_summary) +
   geom_sf(
    data = ship_data %>%
          filter_out(is.na(lon_dd) | is.na(lat_dd)) %>%
          st_as_sf(coords = c("lon_dd", "lat_dd"), crs = "EPSG:4326") %>%
          st_transform(crs = "EPSG:2237")
  ) +
    # geom_path(aes(x = lon_dd, y = lat_dd, color = as.character(date))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
ship_plt
```

```{r}

ship_data %>%
  filter_out(is.na(lon_dd) | is.na(lat_dd)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon_dd", "lat_dd"), crs = "EPSG:4326") %>%
  st_transform(crs = "EPSG:2237") %>%
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1]
  )
  as_tibble()

slice(ship_data, 1:10) %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = ymd_hms(paste(date, time2))
  )

ship_summary %>%
  filter(if_any(everything(), ~is.na(.x))) %>%
  distinct(pick(date, time2)) %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = ymd_hms(paste(date, time2))
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    ship_data,
    by = c("date", "time2")
  )
```
